newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ labour costs rise 2.2 pct in yr to March qtr.
newsitem.headline: NZ labour costs rise 2.2 pct in yr to March qtr.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand (SNZ) on Thursday released the following labour cost data for the March quarter.
Salary and wage rates (including overtime) pct change from previous qtr:
Mar 1997 qtr Dec 1996 qtr Mar 1996 qtr
+0.7 pct +0.7 pct +0.5 pct
Salary and wage rates (including overtime) pct change from same qtr of previous yr:
Mar 1997 qtr Dec 1996 qtr Mar 1996 qtr
+2.2 pct +2.0 pct +1.9 pct
(Note - The median of economists' forecasts was for a 0.5 percent quarterly rise, and a 2.1 percent annual rise in overall labour costs)
Salary and ordinary time wage rates, change from same qtr of previous yr:
Mar 1997 qtr Dec 1996 qtr Mar 1996 qtr
+2.2 pct +2.0 pct +2.0 pct
Overtime wage rates, change from same qtr of previous yr:
Mar 1997 qtr Dec 1996 qtr Mar 1996 qtr
+1.9 pct +2.0 pct +1.2 pct
Private sector salary and wage rates, pct change from same qtr of previous yr:
Mar 1997 qtr Dec 1996 qtr Mar 1996 qtr
+2.0 pct +1.8 pct +1.9 pct
(Note - The median of economists' forecasts was for a 1.8 percent annual rise in private sector labour costs)
Public sector salary and wage rates, pct change from same qtr of previous yr:
Mar 1997 qtr Dec 1996 qtr Mar 1996 qtr
+2.9 pct +2.5 pct +2.0 pct
--Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
